text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket seems to be
troubled by something...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I just don't get it...
Why am I feeling so sluggish?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm eating plenty of food,
and I sleep soundly at night too, but still...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ――Hah! N-No, no good! Thinking about it is making my head all fuzzy!?

...It seems fatigue has built up.
Perhaps I should reconsider the race schedule.
